note: native = Odoo Studio automation / scheduled action / server action. ai = external AI agent via MCP/API writing back to Odoo (human-approved where it changes price/sends external comms).

native_automations.name: Overbooking guard
native_automations.action: detect overlapping reservations on same room serial; alert front desk

native_automations.name: Dynamic seasonal pricing
native_automations.action: adjust pricelist rates by occupancy & season thresholds

native_automations.name: Housekeeping task on checkout
native_automations.action: create cleaning task; flag room not-ready

native_automations.name: Occupancy/revenue threshold alert
native_automations.action: notify management when occupancy crosses thresholds

native_automations.name: OTA payout reconciliation flag
native_automations.action: match OTA payout to commission bill; flag variance

ai_agent_automations.name: Omni-channel AI concierge (FB/WhatsApp/Viber/IG/Web)
ai_agent_automations.io: inbound message on any channel -> auto-translate (EN/Simplified+Traditional Chinese) -> answer FAQ -> capture lead -> log to Odoo CRM for next-day staff approval
ai_agent_automations.approval: info auto; bookings/quotes queued for staff approval next day
ai_agent_automations.note: Directly from discovery: Andrew to provide chatbot FAQs; replaces manual multi-channel handling by reservations.

ai_agent_automations.name: Dive Shop Daily Briefing
ai_agent_automations.io: 06:30 cron -> pull tides+marine weather+local advisories + read Odoo roster/gear/maintenance -> AI composes brief + safety flags -> post to FB/WhatsApp/Viber group -> collect ✅ confirmations -> log back to Odoo
ai_agent_automations.approval: auto-post; go/no-go confirmed by dive lead
ai_agent_automations.note: Fixes the discovery #1 pain: broken, unaccountable group-chat dive comms.

ai_agent_automations.name: AI guest concierge chatbot
ai_agent_automations.io: web/FB message -> create crm.lead / quotation via MCP
ai_agent_automations.approval: auto for info, human for quotes over threshold

ai_agent_automations.name: AI review-response drafting
ai_agent_automations.io: new review -> drafts reply from booking + sentiment context

ai_agent_automations.name: Dive-buddy / boat-fill matching

ai_agent_automations.name: Photo-gallery delivery
